tables.name: Age
tables.description: Modifies Population Density. Older cities may be more disorganized; younger ones may have been planned on a grid or a wheel and spokes.

results.name: Recent
results.description: The city’s final work was completed within the past 10 years. (-2 to population density roll)

results.name: Established
results.description: The city has been around for at least 10, but up to 100, years. (-1 to population density roll)

results.name: Mature
results.description: The city has been around at least 100, but up to 300, years. (+0 to population density roll)

results.name: Old
results.description: The city has been around for 300 to 1000 years. (+1 to population density roll)

results.name: Ancient
results.description: The city is older than living, and possibly even recorded, memory. (+2 to population density roll)
